Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser

Class HistoryStore

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.HistoryStore
public final class HistoryStore extends Object
The in-memory browsing history: a de-duplicated, capacity-capped list kept newest-first. Like BookmarkStore it performs no file I/O — BrowserStore loads and saves the list — so the retention logic is unit-testable headless.

record(java.lang.String, java.lang.String) moves an already-seen URL to the front and bumps its visit count rather than appending a duplicate, then trims the tail to the capacity. Transient pages (about:, data:, javascript:, view-source:) are never recorded so the history holds real destinations only.
